Owner: auditctl (tracked in agentops; auditctl has no local sprintctl, per the #2063 precedent).

auditctl main carries two landed changes that are inert until released: c094ad4 binds the terminal-reason contract to the dispatch.exit event type rather than to its retired first writer's source name, and fb8ee82 removes require_artifacts_root, a dead function stating a requirement dropped in 0.1.4. The SubagentStop hook writes dispatch.exit through the installed CLI, so neither takes effect until a release is installed.

The blocker is not a test failure. tests/test_verification_contracts.py::test_central_result_digest_matches_the_packaged_implementation_tree asserts that one named packet, verification/results/central-observation-ingest-item-1201.json, records an implementation_sha equal to the packaged tree. pyproject.toml is inside CENTRAL_IMPLEMENTATION_PATHS, so every version bump falsifies it and the only route back to green is to rewrite that packet.

That packet is not a digest. It is an observation of one run, carrying its own claims, counterexamples, execution bounds and a note about a timezone defect found in the first adapter read-path run. Restamping its implementation_sha makes that narrative describe a tree it was never run against. auditctl's own boundary rule settles it without an owner decision: a ledger records what was observed and never states what should be. The 0.1.6 release restamped, so item-1201 already asserts a run it did not have.

Scope: (1) change the digest assertion to require that SOME result for this context matches the packaged tree, preserving the guarantee that the shipped tree is verified while letting observations accumulate; (2) add a new result packet named for this item, recording the run actually performed, leaving item-1201 unchanged; (3) bump to 0.1.7 and release.

Verification: run the central verification per docs/operations/running-the-central-verification.md, with PostgreSQL realized through nix shell. Measured on 2026-08-30 at fb8ee82: 143 passed, 1 skipped, and 144 passed with the 0.1.7 wheel present.

Note for a later reader: item ids 1201, 1202 and 1207 named by the other result filenames resolve in no repo scope reachable today. Only 2063 does. Those references are dangling and are not repaired here.
items.title: Re-verify and release auditctl 0.1.7 without restamping an observation
